description: Standard HTML text input component with Tailwind-based styling. Supports all native input types, disabled state, error state (via border-destructive class), and icon prefix/suffix patterns. Designed to be used within FormItem for accessible form integration.
useCases: Text, email, password, and number fields in survey settings and user forms
Search inputs in survey lists, question banks, and analytics filters
Inline editing fields for survey titles, question text, and labels
Form fields with validation error states and icon affordances
